Final for Publication

TYPE | ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS 1001-03 SOUTH CAMPBELL AVENUE
FROM RS 3.5 TO RT4

Applicant seeks a Type | Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the
current RT 3.5 District to that of an RT 4 District for the property commonly known 1001-03
South Campbell Avenue. The site is currently unimproved. Applicant seeks to improve the
site with a single family residence. The property is located in the Near West ARO.
However, the proposal is exempt because it does not meet the definition of a rezoning or
entitlement as defined by the ARO. The amendment is sought for Minimum Lot Area
purposes. Additionally, the request is made to correct a non-conformity, as the existing lot
is non-conforming under the present zoning and, therefore, unbuildable without zoning
relief. Finally, the proposed development is 1 unit. ARO fractional calculations would
require no affordable units.

The following is a list of the proposed bulk and density of the development:

1001-03 SOUTH CAMPBELL AVENUE

Lot Area: 1,910 square feet
Density: 1 residential dwelling unit
Lot Area Per Unit: 1,910 square feet
Off Street Parking: 2 spaces

Height: 30 feet 10 inches
Floor Area: 1,596 square feet
Floor Area Ratio: 0.835

Front Setback: O feet

Rear Setback: 13.74 feet

West Side Setback: 9.52 feet

South Side Setback: 3.34 feet

Type | filing as per section 17-13-0303-D Optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation.
Specifically, seeking 17-13-1101-B Variation: Applicant seeks all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans. Specifically, seeking Variation for
reduced required front and side setbacks.
